description: This file defines an interface IEventHubReceiver and a class EventHubReceiverProxy for interacting with Azure Event Hubs, including methods for receiving messages and closing the receiver, along with internal logging.

classes.name: EventHubReceiverProxy
classes.description: A pass-through decorator class implementing IEventHubReceiver for Azure Event Hubs, managing message reception and connection handling.

methods.name: ReceiveAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously receives a batch of EventData messages from the Event Hub.

methods.name: CloseAsync
methods.description: Closes the EventHub receiver connection asynchronously.

methods.name: GetEventPosition
methods.description: Determines the starting position for reading from the Event Hub based on offset and configuration.
